scripts.postinstall: node -e "const e=process.env;console.log('DIAG NODE_ENV='+e.NODE_ENV+' npm_config_production='+e.npm_config_production+' npm_config_omit='+e.npm_config_omit+' npm_config_only='+e.npm_config_only+' VERCEL_ENV='+e.VERCEL_ENV+' node='+process.version)" && npm config get omit && npm config get production && ls node_modules/.bin | grep -c . && (ls node_modules/typescript/package.json || echo sem-typescript) ; npm run build -w @estoque/shared
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc -p e2e && tsc -p scripts
